name: alpinejs-tools
description: Alpine.js IntelliSense, syntax highlighting, and tooling for VS Code

enumDescriptions: Underline in the editor only, without adding an entry to the Problems panel. The Quick Fix stays available.
alpinejsTools.diagnostics.unknownDirecti.markdownDescription:
Severity for the warning on `x-*` attributes that aren't recognised Alpine directives.

Set to `hint` to keep the check and its Quick Fix while getting it out of the Problems panel. If the warning is firing on a valid directive from a third-party plugin, add the name to `#alpinejsTools.extraDirectives#` rather than turning the check off.

enumDescriptions: Underline in the editor only, without adding an entry to the Problems panel. The Quick Fix stays available.
alpinejsTools.diagnostics.jsxShorthand.s.markdownDescription:
Severity for the warning on Alpine's `@event` / `:attr` shorthands used as JSX attribute names in `.jsx`/`.tsx` files.

These are hard TypeScript syntax errors (`TS1003` / `TS1382`) whatever this is set to; turning it off only removes the message that explains why, and the Quick Fix that rewrites `@click` to `x-on:click`.

alpinejsTools.extraDirectives.markdownDescription:
Additional directive names to treat as valid, for third-party Alpine plugins that this extension doesn't bundle documentation for.

Write them with or without the `x-` prefix — `x-clipboard` and `clipboard` are equivalent — and without arguments or modifiers. Names listed here are exempt from the unknown-directive warning and are offered as "did you mean" suggestions.

Alpine's core directives and the six official plugin directives (`x-intersect`, `x-collapse`, `x-sort`, `x-mask`, `x-trap`, `x-anchor`) are always recognised and don't need listing.

alpinejsTools.workspaceScan.exclude.markdownDescription:
Glob patterns to keep out of the workspace scan for `Alpine.data()` and `Alpine.store()` registrations — for example `["**/dist/**", "**/vendor/**"]`.

`node_modules` is always excluded and doesn't need listing. Use this when the output channel reports that the scan hit its 2000-file-per-extension limit: excluding build output brings the count under the limit, which is what restores the missing completions.

Affects the initial scan and the **Alpine.js Tools: Rescan Workspace** command.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
